gaps: P0–P1: only icons and a reconstruction of the Hanseatic Peterhof, no town view; P3: only icons; P6: existing aerial view kept
notes: #10: dated by Commons to the 1656 enlarged edition of Olearius; the plate may already appear in the 1647 first edition. Other P2 options: #9 (Mayerberg’s 1661 panorama, a very narrow strip over a text block), #11 (Palmquist 1674, two thin panoramas on one sheet), #12 (Witsen 1665, a book spread with a gutter). #20 (bird’s-eye postcard over the kremlin wall, about 1900) is a good P4 alternative but black and white. #19 (1883 panorama) is too narrow (14:1). #17 is dated 1860, before the Millennium monument it shows was unveiled (1862), so skipped.
